intro: I'm an Aerospace Engineering graduate from IIT Kanpur who works across hardware, software, AI, and aerospace, focusing on AI infrastructure, real-time systems, aerospace, and physical computing.
bio: I'm an Aerospace Engineering graduate from IIT Kanpur. I've worked across aerospace, space technology, AI, and hardware data systems, including roles at GalaxEye Space and NabhDrishti Aerospace, and building products of my own. Most recently, I built XpectraFlow, a telemetry and data infrastructure system for mission-critical hardware and testing. I like problems that sit between disciplines—where software has to understand hardware, data has to work in real time, and engineering constraints matter.
